facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the education ministry announced on 25 February 2026 the launch of digital registration of primary pupils, to build a digital register giving each pupil a single school identity from entry to primary school, with examination officers and data managers of the regional, prefectoral and communal education offices starting training on the platform.

Agence Ecofin reports the registration launched on 25 February 2026 is for pupils of primary school; the article describes a launch and staff training and gives no count of pupils or schools registered.
Agence Ecofin reports, quoting the ministry, that training on the pupil registration platform is coordinated by the ministry's direction générale des examens et contrôle scolaire.

systems.country_label: immatriculation numérique des élèves du primaire
systems.owner: Ministère chargé de l'Éducation nationale, direction générale des examens et contrôle scolaire
systems.tiers: those trained are examination officers and data managers at regional (IRE), prefectoral (DPE) and communal (DCE) education offices; no school-level use is stated

note: Classed emis as a learner register (one identity per pupil). The article does not say who enters the pupils or whether schools do; the only users it names are staff of the education offices above the school, so no 'kept' or 'schools' fact is taken.
